summary: No ruling authorizes the test phase's pushes of Architecture (it redeploys prd, and the runbook's registration step is the operator's) and of JenkinsPipelineUtils (the standing each-push-needs-OK rule was dropped from the plan), or P8's hook on PipelinesDeploy. Only the operator can close that gap (F1). V07/P6 define the monorepo reference file as what the scripted ModernAppTemplate renders, against declarative-only and the full linter check (F2). Three advisory notes.
